Name: Chinese Translation of June - Custom NPC for Ridgeside Village (OBSOLETE)
Author: ch20youk
Description:
Update: As of RSV 2.3, June is now a part of the Ridgeside Village mod itself. A Mandarin Chinese translation is available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9247]here[/url].

六月NPC中文翻译补丁，由夜猫翻译.要安装的话，请将此文件解压缩到您的六月NPCmod文件夹中，了.

Nightcat has provided this Simplified Chinese translation patch for my custom NPC [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10100]June[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]. To install, please download the original June mod, and then extract this translation patch into the June mod folder (not separately into its own folder - the English files in the June folder must be overwritten in order for these Chinese ones to appear). After each update, please reinstall this translation patch as well, as the English files will have been reinstalled with the update.

Note: If your Stardew Valley game version is not in Chinese, the Chinese characters will not show up in your game.

Since I don't speak Chinese, I am unable to test this mod, but please let me know if there are any errors and Nightcat and I will work together to identify them and fix them.
